description: DILA LEGI open-data exports (the Légifrance database): the latest full export and every later daily increment, reduced to the article files of the Code de la propriété intellectuelle and the Code de commerce.
access_notes: www.legifrance.gouv.fr answered a plain GET for the CPI page with HTTP 403 and a Cloudflare managed challenge on October 22, 2026, so the site's pages are not read; the PISTE Légifrance API needs registered OAuth credentials.

Kept: CPI articles numbered L… (the legislative part) and Code de commerce articles L151-1 to L154-1 (Book I, Title V, trade secrets). Each article's version in force on the snapshot date is selected.
